descriptors.concept_name: Change in tax status of an entity or its shareholders
descriptors.definition: A modification in the taxation classification of an organization or its investors alters future tax rates and asset recovery consequences. Such adjustments impact profit or loss unless the underlying events directly affect equity or other comprehensive income.
inclusion: Tax consequences affecting profit or loss
Tax effects relating to items recognized in equity
Tax effects relating to items recognized in other comprehensive income
exclusion: Increases or decreases in amounts recognized outside profit or loss unrelated to equity or OCI
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from routine temporary difference reversals by stemming from structural status alterations rather than operational asset recovery.

descriptors.definition: Financial statement reporting mandates extend beyond recognition and measurement to encompass detailed disclosures regarding income taxes. These disclosures explain tax expenses, equity charges, and other tax-related line items.
inclusion: Major components of tax expense
Taxes related to items charged directly to equity
exclusion: Initial recognition and measurement rules detailed in earlier sections
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from core recognition principles by focusing strictly on note disclosures and explanatory breakdowns.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure 1: Disclose components of tax expenses (income)
descriptors.definition: Entities must separately disclose major components of tax expense or income within the financial statements. This includes current tax, prior period adjustments, and deferred tax movements.
inclusion: Current tax expense
Deferred tax expense relating to origination and reversal of temporary differences
Tax expense relating to accounting policy changes and errors
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from aggregate balance sheet totals by itemizing specific profit or loss tax drivers.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure 2: Tax related to items charged directly to equity
descriptors.definition: Current and deferred taxes associated with items credited or charged directly to equity must be accounted for and disclosed accordingly. Examples include retrospective accounting policy adjustments and the initial equity component of compound instruments.
inclusion: Aggregate current and deferred tax related to equity items
Retained earnings opening balance adjustments from error corrections
exclusion: Taxes recognized through profit or loss or other comprehensive income
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from OCI tax disclosures by isolating items bypassing profit or loss straight into equity components.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure 3: Tax related to items recognised in statement of other comprehensive income
descriptors.definition: Income taxes relating to items recognized in other comprehensive income must be accounted for and disclosed for each component. Examples include asset revaluations and foreign operation translation differences.
terminology: revaluation of property plant and equipment
inclusion: Tax relating to property, plant and equipment revaluations
Tax relating to foreign operation exchange differences
exclusion: Tax expenses affecting standard profit or loss from ordinary activities
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from direct equity charges by applying specifically to elements traversing the statement of other comprehensive income.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure 4: Explanation of the relationship between tax expense (income) and accounting profit
descriptors.definition: Entities must provide a numerical reconciliation explaining the variance between accounting profit multiplied by applicable rates and actual tax expense. This explanation can use either monetary tax amounts or effective tax rate percentages.
inclusion: Numerical reconciliation of tax expense against accounting profit product
Numerical reconciliation of average effective tax rate against applicable tax rate
exclusion: Standard balance sheet tax asset and liability schedules
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from component breakdowns by offering a conceptual bridge between pre-tax accounting profits and final tax expense calculations.

descriptors.definition: Explanations must be provided whenever applicable tax rates shift compared to the prior period. These shifts can stem from legislative revisions, structural entity changes, or asset recovery alterations.
inclusion: Explanations for tax rate variations across accounting periods
exclusion: Static tax rate disclosures under constant legislative frameworks
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from general tax expense breakdowns by explicitly targeting the rationale behind shifting statutory percentages.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure 6: Unrecognised deductible temporary differences, unused tax losses and unused tax credits
descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose the monetary amounts and expiry dates of deductible temporary differences, unused tax losses, and tax credits lacking deferred tax asset recognition. This reporting applies when standard recognition criteria cannot be fulfilled.
inclusion: Amounts of unrecognised deductible temporary differences
Expiry dates of unrecognised tax losses and tax credits
exclusion: Deferred tax assets successfully recognized on the balance sheet
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from recognized asset disclosures by focusing exclusively on potential tax benefits excluded from the balance sheet due to strict criteria.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure 7: Temporary differences associated with investments in subsidiaries etc.
descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose the aggregate temporary differences linked to investments in subsidiaries, branches, associates, and joint ventures where deferred tax liabilities remain unrecognised. Disclosing the underlying differences satisfies requirements when computing precise unrecognised liabilities is impracticable.
inclusion: Aggregate temporary differences for unrecognised subsidiary and affiliate liabilities
exclusion: Direct computation of unrecognised deferred tax liabilities when impracticable
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from standard temporary difference disclosures by addressing complex group-structure investments where computation is burdensome.

descriptors.concept_name: Disclosure 8: Amount of deferred tax liabilities (assets) or income (expenses)
descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose recognized deferred tax balances across balance sheet periods alongside associated profit or loss impacts. These figures must be categorized by each distinct type of temporary difference, tax loss, and tax credit.
inclusion: Amounts of deferred tax assets and liabilities recognized in the balance sheet
Deferred tax income or expense recognized in profit or loss
exclusion: Unrecognised tax positions and off-balance-sheet items
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from aggregate tax expense lines by offering granular balance sheet tracking for individual temporary difference categories.

descriptors.definition: Tax expenses connected to discontinued operations must be separately disclosed for both discontinuance gains or losses and ordinary operational profits. These disclosures must also incorporate comparative prior period amounts.
inclusion: Tax expense relating to gain or loss on discontinuance
Tax expense relating to profit or loss from ordinary activities of discontinued operations
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from core continuing operation tax disclosures by segregating discontinued business lines and their unique exit metrics.

descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose the income tax consequences of dividends proposed or declared after the reporting date but prior to financial statement approval. Such dividend tax impacts are omitted from balance sheet liabilities but require explicit disclosure.
inclusion: Income tax consequences of dividends proposed after reporting date but before approval
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from recognized liabilities by targeting post-reporting date unrecognised corporate distributions.
